claims.content: To allow a C2 JU to manage track identity classification by accepting, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.

goal.raw_text: To allow a C2 JU to manage track identity classification by accepting, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.

claims.content: C2 JU

The C2 JU has elected to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1.
The new identity received in the track report is Friend.
The locally held identity is not Hostile.
A C2 JU receives a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, containing changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU receives a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, containing changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator.

claims.content: The C2 JU receives a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, containing changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator.
The C2 JU automatically accepts the changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in the track report.
The C2 JU verifies that the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile before accepting the change.

If the track report contains a change in Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, or Special Interest Indicator field values, the C2 JU includes the appropriate evaluation of these fields in the J3.X or J7.0 (ACT = 1) message.

When accepting a remote ID change, the C2 JU retains the received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields for retransmission and operator appreciation, where those fields are implemented.

If a Platform, Platform Activity, or Specific Type value of 0 (No Statement) is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU does not retain the received value during difference resolution.
If an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker Boom Only), or 8 (Tanker Drogue Only) is held locally and a different value is received, the C2 JU may optionally generate an operator alert.

Differences in Environment/Category, ID, Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, Exercise Indicator, and Special Interest Indicator field values may also be resolved using the J7.0 (ACT = 2) message.

If a Platform, Platform Activity, or Specific Type value of 0 (No Statement) is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU does not retain the received value during difference resolution.
If an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker Boom Only), or 8 (Tanker Drogue Only) is held locally and a different value is received, the C2 JU may optionally generate an operator alert.
The changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in the track report have been automatically accepted by the C2 JU.
The new identity for the track is set to Friend.
The locally held identity remains not Hostile.

If a change in Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, or Special Interest Indicator was included, the appropriate evaluation of these fields has been performed and included in the J3.X or J7.0 (ACT = 1) message.

The received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields are retained by the C2 JU for retransmission and operator appreciation, where those fields are implemented.
